boundedExceptions.proof: Removing this exact copper record leaves exactly two native-pad islands; the leaf contains only the resistor input, and the other retains both inlet and driver supply pins.

outer_motor_pd_actual_cam.method: Parse actual RS274X copper and Excellon drills independently; require each native-policy-approved wire strip on its designated outer copper layer after drilled voids are removed. Actual CAM net-island assignment, spacing, source equality and archive equality must separately PASS. Analytic rounding tolerance 0.0002 mm. Native bounded fanouts and resistor-only leaves remain explicitly distinguished from main-width strips.
outer_motor_pd_actual_cam.via_path_scope: Minimum available via-layer changes in actual plated-drill/copper-island topology; total branched via counts remain in the native policy. Does not model current splitting, distributed resistance, temperatures or hardware operation. Native component PTH contacts are not counted as routing vias.

full_jst_inside_board.scope: Full XY body bounds, not pad row; assumed placement/outline tolerances are fabrication requirements, physical sample remains unqualified.

software_scope: Current source/build/native connectivity/DRC/trace-width/actualCAM/drill/stencil/shorts, nativeA4 browser and mechanical installation screens. Historical files outside this list are not current acceptance evidence.
offline_checks: PASS with retained native placement exit1 advisories and generic NPN ERC warning; exact generic header-post model discrepancy openly unresolved.
remaining_qualification_items: Winding current/balance/torque and sense/return parasitics including low-VREF A4988 accuracy
USB enumeration/ROM programming/application firmware and15V PD behavior

Regeneration/hot-plug clamp energy and exact selected protection data
Mounted temperatures and Holtek worst-load thermal/transient margin
Factory JST post/key/spring CAD versus generic supplier model discrepancy
Biased/aged effective capacitor values and converter stability/current margins
Temperature/material/splice certificates and factory motor lead stock
